verdicts.reason: Issue 18: fraud requires statement made 'knowingly, without belief in its truth, or recklessly'; negligent belief insufficient.
Derry v Peek cited at E4a table row and Issue 18 Standard; also Three Rivers DC (No 3) on pleading fraud.
Issue 22 quotes cll. 11.3.1/11.3.2 supersession and non-reliance; 'no claim for innocent or negligent misrepresentation' outside SPA.
D1: 'Fraud can never be excluded'; s.3 Misrep Act 1967 / UCTA s.11 reasonableness; clauses defeat every limb other than fraud.
Issue 37: 'Damages for injury to commercial reputation are not generally recoverable in contract'; separate Remoteness heading rebuts reasonable contemplation.
Issue 37: Charter A a lost tender or terminated for Horizon's own default (novus actus); Charter B lost chance, unproven.
